build_hrfpn_backbone: build an HRFPN backbone from a Detectron2 config for DensePose dense human pose estimation
create_HRFPN_instance: create an HRFPN module with HRNet bottom-up features and configurable pooling and shared convolution
run_HRFPN_forward: run the HRFPN forward pass to transform multi-scale HRNet features into feature pyramids for ROI heads
init_HRFPN_weights: initialize HRFPN convolution weights using Kaiming normal initialization with zero bias
review_HRFPN_architecture: review the HRFPN class architecture including interp_conv, reduction_pooling_conv, and fpn_conv modules
